description_en: Modifies the layouts of cloud computer list headers, such as the required fields and the display and hide settings
description_zh: 修改云电脑列表页表头的显示类型（包括必选、显示和隐藏）
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-customized-list-headers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --list-type desktop --headers DisplayType=display HeaderKey=pay_type --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCustomizedListHeaders

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the list.

Valid values:

desktop: cloud computer

parameters.name: list_type

fields.help_en:
The display type of the header.

For the desktop_id_name and office_site_id_name head keys, set the value of this parameter to required. For other header keys, set the value of this parameter to display or hide based on your requirements
fields.help_zh:
表头的显示类型。

<notice>`desktop_id_name`和`office_site_id_name`的值必须设为`required`，其他HeaderKey的值可按需设为`display`或`hide`。></notice>
fields.name: display_type
